hints.title: Classify Mismatches
hints.text: Count positions where s has '0' and t has '1' (c01) and where s has '1' and t has '0' (c10).

hints.title: Swapping Opposing Mismatches
hints.text: A swap can fix one (0->1) and one (1->0) mismatch simultaneously at cost swap_cost.

hints.title: Compare Swap vs Double Flip
hints.text: If swap_cost < 2 * flip_cost, greedily perform min(c01, c10) swaps and resolve remaining mismatches with single flips.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def minCost(self, s: str, t: str, flip_cost: int, swap_cost: int) -> int:
        c01 = sum(1 for a, b in zip(s, t) if a == '0' and b == '1')
        c10 = sum(1 for a, b in zip(s, t) if a == '1' and b == '0')
        
        pairs = min(c01, c10)
        rem = abs(c01 - c10)
        
        cost_with_swaps = pairs * min(swap_cost, 2 * flip_cost) + rem * flip_cost
        return cost_with_swaps
```

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Trying all sequence of edit operations leads to exponential branch exploration.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Expects grouping mismatches into complementary pairs and comparing swap cost against two flips.
